notes.text: The linked image detail page identifies the same adze as this catalogue record and states that the image may be shared under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). The required credit is “© The Trustees of the British Museum”; commercial use is directed to BM Images. The first carousel image was matched by the accession page’s exact image-detail link, the image page’s description and visual inspection. The supplied 1000-pixel-high JPEG is preserved unchanged; the website build resizes and re-encodes its copies. The curator’s comment quotes the 1920 register: “Found at Rana Raka, when excavating image.” That statement remains a described_as claim alongside the catalogue’s uncertain combined field.
